coverage: Partial production-family identity checkpoint; named historical and current JAC-badged passenger/LCV families. Not complete versions or verified production dates.
excluded: Maextro and VW/Sehol-only products without separately verified JAC export identities.
Heavy trucks, buses, chassis and concepts.
gaps: S4/JS4 evolution and original Refine/M1/M5 periods require finer splitting; identities conservatively grouped.
iEV4/iEV7/iEV7S and other electrified derivatives need exact parent/alias reconciliation; not asserted as separate production families in this checkpoint.
Most engine and gearbox tables remain unavailable; five explicitly sourced versions in four families only.

Production facts individually checked where a single unambiguous infobox period exists. Multi-market periods scoped separately; T9 reported2020 start not used without primary launch/production reconciliation.
GAS Ka removed: production status not independently established. iEV5 Wikipedia redirect actually A20/iEV7 family; corrected identity and excluded planned name as a separate production line.
e-JS4 exact generation start not borrowed from combustion S4. iEV6E removed as E10X alias because an older distinct predecessor is involved.
J6/HeyueRS and S2Mini individual guessed Wikipedia paths404: removed; established list/Yueyue sources retained.
